id.description: ID is a lowercase identifier, unique across the scope document.

name.description: Name is an optional display name.

Component.description: Component is a part of a platform or system that evidence can target.

sharedPlatformStatement.description:
SharedPlatformStatement describes the shared platform without naming
any other system. Sharing is material to an assessment, so it is stated.

Disclosure.description: Disclosure holds the wording a system's external documents use for shared infrastructure.

id.description: ID is a lowercase identifier, such as "example-co".

name.description: Name is the organization's display name.

id.description:
ID is a lowercase identifier, unique across providers, platforms and
systems.

name.description: Name is the platform's display name, for internal use.

description.description: Description says what the platform provides.

providers.description: Providers lists the IDs of providers the platform builds on.

Platform.description: Platform is shared infrastructure operated by the organization.

id.description:
ID is a lowercase identifier, unique across providers, platforms and
systems.

name.description: Name is the provider's display name.

attestations.description:
Attestations describes the provider's own reports or certifications
that the inherited controls rest on, such as "SOC 2 Type II report,
under NDA".

Provider.description: Provider is an external service whose controls are inherited.

schemaVersion.description:
SchemaVersion is the document format version, "scope/v1". Optional;
when absent, version 1 is assumed.

organization.description: Organization is the organization that operates the platforms and systems.

providers.description:
Providers are external services the platforms and systems build on, and
from which they inherit controls.

platforms.description:
Platforms are shared infrastructure the organization operates. A
platform is never assessed alone; its controls are inherited by the
systems that run on it.

systems.description:
Systems are what an audience buys or uses. Each gets its own
assessment, documents and audience.

Scope.description: Scope is one organization's scope document.

id.description:
ID is a lowercase identifier, unique across providers, platforms and
systems.

name.description: Name is the product's display name.

description.description: Description says what the product does.

platforms.description: Platforms lists the IDs of the shared platforms the system runs on.

providers.description:
Providers lists the IDs of providers the system uses directly, beyond
those of its platforms.

components.description: Components lists the parts the system owns.

baseline.description: Baseline is the control baseline the system is assessed against.

addedControls.description:
AddedControls lists control IDs added to the baseline for this system,
such as the PT family for a system that handles children's data.

disclosure.description:
Disclosure says how the system's external documents describe what it
shares with other systems.

System.description: System is a separately marketed product.

title: Scope
description: An organization's external providers, shared platforms and separately marketed systems, and which systems run on which platforms.
